voice.summary: Sounds like a friend showing postcards across a table. Short, upbeat and a bit cheeky, with one memorable detail per place.
dos: Give each place a sensory detail in under ten words
Keep the swipe verbs consistent: pass, like, undo
donts: No brochure superlatives like paradise or hidden gem
No more than one exclamation mark a screen

taglines: Swipe right on places you'd go
Your next trip, one card at a time
Pick a place, skip the rest
boilerplate: Wander Deck is a swipeable deck of destination cards that helps travellers choose between places by instinct, with undo, shortlists and a summary of everywhere they liked.

microcopy.error: That card would not load, try again
microcopy.empty: The deck is empty, start a fresh round

logo.note: A compass needle points to the next destination, the whole point of the deck.
